title: Characterization of a true choice output
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over Boolean strings, $O$ an oracle language, and $x,u$ Boolean words. The output defined from the run using choice sequence $u$ is exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$ if and only if that run halts and its output is exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$.
hypotheses_covered: finite-state nondeterministic oracle machine over Booleans
